textes.hebergements.intro.texte: Treat yourself to a moment of calm in the heart of nature in our comfortable lodges, nestled on the edge of the pond. Private spa, terrace with view, high-end equipment and warm atmosphere await you for a stay dedicated to relaxation.
textes.hebergements.items.le-gite.activites.int: Many activities are possible on site to reconnect with nature:
textes.hebergements.items.le-gite.activites.ite: Fishing on the pond from your private pontoon
Immersion in the heart of the fauna and flora of the Natura 2000 site (ideal for photo enthusiasts and other enthusiasts…)
textes.hebergements.items.le-gite.meta.descript: The Gîte du Domaine de l'Étang Fourchu: old stopover gîte completely renovated in 2022, private spa, sauna, billiards, up to 4 people, in Florimont (90).
textes.hebergements.items.le-gite.prestations.c: To make your stay easier, you will have free cotton satin bed linen, bath linen (bath sheets, bathrobes, slippers and towels, etc.), hygiene products (shower gel, soap, etc.) as well as basic food products (salt, pepper, oil, vinegar, coffee beans, tea, sugar, etc.), thus reducing your luggage.
The interior temperature is adjustable using the remote control provided (heating in winter and air conditioning in summer).
textes.hebergements.items.le-gite.prestations.g: 2 bedrooms with Queen size bed, storage and wardrobe, USB socket…
Bathroom with walk-in shower, heated towel rail, hairdryer
Equipped kitchen (induction hob, oven, coffee bean machine, toaster, dishwasher, fridge-freezer with water distribution, etc.)
Living room with large sofa, armchair, LED TV
Private terrace with dining table and armchairs
textes.hebergements.items.le-gite.prestations.i: For your comfort, we provide you with numerous facilities:
textes.hebergements.items.le-gite.resume: Stay in a completely renovated cottage, nestled in the heart of an exceptional natural environment. Comfort, quality equipment, private spa and numerous activities on the estate await you for a truly relaxing break. Ideal for recharging your batteries, alone, as a couple or with family. Discover this unique place and all it has to offer you.
textes.hebergements.items.le-gite.sections.0.pa: Historically a “stopover lodge” for horseback riding, this accommodation was completely renovated in 2022 in the same spirit as our lodges, in order to provide comfort and well-being to its occupants.
Welcoming equestrian hikers and their horses is still possible on the estate with the provision of paddocks on request.
textes.hebergements.items.le-gite.sections.0.ti: An old stopover lodge renovated for your comfort
textes.hebergements.items.le-gite.sections.1.pa: Located in the heart of an exceptional site conducive to calm and well-being, the cottage can accommodate up to 4 people, it is ideal for resting and disconnecting.
Equipped with luxury equipment and private outdoor facilities, it also offers an opening onto the surrounding nature: everything for a rejuvenating stay.
textes.hebergements.items.le-gite.sections.2.ti: A warm place ideal for sharing good times with others.
textes.hebergements.items.le-gite.sous_titre: Located in the heart of an exceptional site conducive to calm and well-being
textes.hebergements.items.le-gite.supplements.i: Composed mainly of organic and local products, the breakfast will delight you with its great diversity
Organic and local products are available at the direct farm sales shop located at the entrance to Domaine de l'Étang Fourchu
* Rates vary depending on the dates of stay (week, weekend, public holidays and school holidays, etc.)
From €270 per night, decreasing rate from 2 nights.

textes.hebergements.items.lodge-carelie.section: The Domaine de l'Étang Fourchu opens its doors to you for stays in a comfortable Lodge guaranteeing privacy and tranquility.
As each Lodge is designed to limit environmental impact, we offer tourism that allows you to remain in harmony with nature.
Equestrian hikers and their horses will also be welcome with paddocks available on request.
Thanks to quality services, we try to make your getaways unforgettable in the heart of an unusual site conducive to calm and relaxation.
Stay in the heart of nature
Nestled in the heart of nature, our lodges can accommodate up to 4 people.

Each has a kitchen fitted with quality equipment (induction hob, oven, fridge with water distribution, dishwasher, coffee maker, toaster, etc.), a bathroom with spacious walk-in shower, a bedroom with Queen size bed and dressing room. The living room is composed of a very comfortable sofa bed, armchair and an LED TV.
Two large bay windows offer you a breathtaking view of the pond and the surrounding nature opening onto a terrace with dining table and armchairs.
In order to offer you a moment of great relaxation, each lodge is equipped with a private spa, sun loungers and brazier.
Thanks to a pontoon, you can get as close as possible to nature to indulge in relaxation, fishing, boat trips...

textes.interface.Entre étang, forêt et grand ai: Between pond, forest and great outdoors, discover a place designed to recharge your batteries. Fully equipped and accessible accommodation awaits you, with a private spa and a preserved environment, for a moment of calm and disconnection.

textes.pages/accueil.activites.items.0.texte: Stay in the heart of nature in comfortable accommodation offering calm, privacy and a privileged view of the estate.
textes.pages/accueil.activites.items.1.texte: Take advantage of a pond rich in species to enjoy a sport fishing experience in a preserved natural setting.
textes.pages/accueil.activites.items.2.texte: Discover the farm's organic farm products and a selection of local products available for sale directly in the store.
textes.pages/accueil.citation.texte: Each stay is an invitation to slow down, enjoy the calm and discover the local flavors from our farm.
textes.pages/accueil.citation.titre: For several years, the Domaine de l'Étang Fourchu has welcomed nature lovers in a preserved setting, with comfortable accommodation, sport fishing and an organic farm.
textes.pages/accueil.ferme.titre: Direct sale of organic and local farm products
textes.pages/accueil.hero.surtitre: Domaine de l’Étang Fourchu — Florimont, Territoire de Belfort
textes.pages/accueil.hero.texte: The Domaine de l'Étang Fourchu welcomes you in a preserved natural setting, between pond, forests and peaceful landscapes. Enjoy an ideal place to recharge your batteries, practice fishing or discover local farm products from organic farming. An authentic place where nature, relaxation and terroir meet.
textes.pages/accueil.hero.titre: Live an experience in the heart of nature
textes.pages/accueil.meta.description: Le Domaine de l'Étang Fourchu in Florimont (90): lodges with private spa, gîte, sport fishing and organic farm, between Territoire de Belfort and Alsace.
textes.pages/accueil.piliers.cta: Treat yourself to a moment of nature and relaxation today.
textes.pages/accueil.piliers.items.0.texte: A preserved natural area dedicated to lovers of calm and wide open spaces. L’Étang Fourchu offers an ideal setting to relax and enjoy an authentic environment.
textes.pages/accueil.piliers.items.1.texte: The Domaine welcomes you for stays in comfortable accommodation, designed to offer you privacy, tranquility and a real break in the heart of nature.
textes.pages/accueil.piliers.items.2.texte: L'Étang Fourchu also offers sport fishing with a stock of varied fish, as well as an organic farm offering animal discovery and direct sales of local farm products.
textes.pages/boutique.bio_local.paragraphes.0: Over the years, partner producers committed to organic farming have joined our store. Every week you will find seasonal fruits and vegetables, poultry to order, as well as a wide choice of dairy products: cow, goat or sheep cheeses, butter, cream and regional specialties.
textes.pages/boutique.bio_local.paragraphes.1: Our grocery store completes the offer with flour, pasta, jams, syrups, honey, herbal teas, wines and craft beers. We also offer some non-food items such as wooden toys, soaps and decorative items.
textes.pages/boutique.histoire.paragraphes.0: Cattle breeding, forage crops, respect for nature... our operation has evolved over time to remain faithful to the essential: producing better, in harmony with its environment.
textes.pages/boutique.histoire.paragraphes.1: Committed to organic farming since 2010 and located in the Natura 2000 zone, we have chosen responsible production, respectful of the land and animals. In 2013, we opened our farm store to allow everyone easy access to local, healthy and quality products.
textes.pages/boutique.histoire.titre: Since 1864, the Ferme de l'Étang Fourchu has brought to life agricultural know-how rooted in the Territoire de Belfort.
textes.pages/boutique.horaires: The store is open Friday from 4 p.m. to 7 p.m. and Saturday from 9 a.m. to 12 p.m.
textes.pages/boutique.meta.description: The Ferme de l'Étang Fourchu shop in Florimont (90): organic beef, free-range eggs, apple juice, seasonal fruits and vegetables and local products for direct sale.
textes.pages/boutique.production.paragraphes.0: Our beef, mainly Limousin breed, is born and raised on the farm. The animals are fed exclusively with grass, hay and cereals produced on site. Pink veal raised on mother's milk, beef from heifers or primiparous calves: each piece reflects our standards and our commitment.
textes.pages/boutique.production.paragraphes.1: Our eggs come from free-range hens fed with farm cereals. Our apple juice, made from organic varieties, is pressed then carefully pasteurized.
textes.pages/boutique.produits.0.details.0: PINK VEAL fed on breast milk, grass, hay and cereals — Package of 10 kg: €17.50 per kilo or retail (price in store)
textes.pages/boutique.produits.0.details.1: BEEF heifer or primiparous, aged 2 to 4 years — Package of 10 kg: €16.50 per kilo or retail (price in store)
textes.pages/boutique.produits.0.texte: Limousin and crossbred meat breed, born and raised on the farm, fed 100% of the farm's production
textes.pages/boutique.produits.1.texte: Free-range chickens fed on cereals produced on the farm
textes.pages/boutique.produits.2.details.0: 1 liter: €3.00 with a deposit of €0.30 or €2.70 per liter
textes.pages/boutique.produits.2.texte: A mixture of varieties all from organic farming, our juice is pasteurized.
textes.pages/boutique.produits.3.texte: Every week the store offers you seasonal fruits and vegetables from locally produced organic farming (Territoire de Belfort, Alsace)
textes.pages/boutique.produits.4.texte: On order, date subject to availability
textes.pages/boutique.produits.5.details.0: Comté, Morbier, bleu de Gex, cream, butter, cancoillotte, Munster, plain or flavored cow cheese, various goat cheeses…
textes.pages/boutique.produits.6.texte: Flour (wheat, rye, spelt, einkorn, buckwheat, etc.), pasta, jams, syrups, herbal teas, vinegar, honey, beer, white and red wine, crémant, etc.
textes.pages/boutique.produits.7.details.0: For any special occasion, we make garnished baskets on request.
textes.pages/boutique.produits.7.texte: Wooden toys, soaps, and various decorations

textes.pages/peche.meta.description: No-kill sport fishing at the Domaine de l'Étang Fourchu in Florimont (90): Étang Fourchu (13 stations) and Étang Florimont (3.75 ha, boats allowed).
textes.pages/reglement.conclusion.0: Payment for your session constitutes acceptance of the regulations governing the various sites of the “Domaine de l’Étang Fourchu”.
textes.pages/reglement.conclusion.1: The management reserves the right to expel any fisherman who does not respect the regulations without reimbursement of the stay.
textes.pages/reglement.hero.titre: Rules of life and instructions of the Domaine
textes.pages/reglement.meta.description: General regulations of the Domaine de l'Étang Fourchu: rules of life and instructions common to all fishing sites on the estate.
textes.pages/reglement.regles.0: Fishing is no-kill on all species.
textes.pages/reglement.regles.10: Visitors must leave their vehicle in the parking lot reserved for them.
textes.pages/reglement.regles.11: The management declines all responsibility in the event of theft, damage on the site or accident of any kind.
textes.pages/reglement.regles.12: No recourse can be made to the owner
textes.pages/reglement.regles.13: “Nature” toilets are available around the area
textes.pages/reglement.regles.14: Barbecues, gas stoves and camping are authorized, ground fires are prohibited under penalty of immediate exclusion.
textes.pages/reglement.regles.15: It is strictly forbidden to damage nature by cutting surrounding branches and trees.
textes.pages/reglement.regles.16: The positions are allocated to you specific to your arrival, they must remain so for the entire duration of your stay as well as upon your departure. Waste and cigarette butts must be removed by you.
textes.pages/reglement.regles.17: Our dog friends are accepted provided they do not create any nuisance towards other users. They must be tied up and their excrement must be collected by you.
textes.pages/reglement.regles.2: Minor guests must be accompanied by an adult for the entire stay. Otherwise, a written release from the legal representative will be requested beforehand.
textes.pages/reglement.regles.3: The number of accompanying persons is limited to two per station, these remaining the entire responsibility of the fisherman.
textes.pages/reglement.regles.4: The area is a calm and peaceful place, the volume of equipment must not exceed the limit of the fishing station as well as the lighting.
textes.pages/reglement.regles.5: Drugs and excess alcoholic beverages are prohibited under penalty of legal proceedings and immediate exclusion without refund.
textes.pages/reglement.regles.6: During the week, arrivals and departures must only take place during the day (sunrise and sunset)
textes.pages/reglement.regles.7: Friday departures must take place before 12 p.m. (noon)
textes.pages/reglement.regles.8: Weekend arrivals will be permitted from Friday 2 p.m. until Sunday 4 p.m. No deviation from these times will be tolerated.
textes.pages/reglement.regles.9: All car traffic on the site is prohibited other than arrivals and departures. Maximum speed 10 km/hour
textes.pages/reglement.sous_titre: (Common to all sites in the domain)
textes.peche.intro.texte: Take advantage of a pond rich in species to enjoy a sport fishing experience in a preserved natural setting.
textes.peche.items.etang-florimont.meta.descrip: Fishing at the Florimont pond (90): 3.75 ha rich in carp and catfish, boats authorized, two exclusive stations. Prices and reservation.
textes.peche.items.etang-florimont.recapitulati: Boat authorized. Vests required. Limited to 4 rods.
Located upstream of Étang Fourchu, Étang Florimont offers a fishing area of 3.75 hectares in the heart of wild and preserved nature.

Open since 2018, this exceptional site is distinguished by its wealth of carp and catfish. It offers a unique experience, different from neighboring sites, thanks to the authorization of boats. The pond has two exclusive fishing stations to guarantee calm and serenity.
textes.peche.items.etang-florimont.resume: Located upstream of Étang Fourchu, Étang Florimont offers a fishing area of 3.75 hectares rich in carp and catfish, with authorized boats and two exclusive stations.
textes.peche.items.etang-florimont.sous_titre: The site is open every day of the year, excluding frost periods.
textes.peche.items.etang-florimont.specificites: The boat and other craft, bait boat are authorized under your entire responsibility.
Life jacket required when using a boat
textes.peche.items.etang-florimont.tarification: Please note: a weekend session has a fixed price of €70 (from Friday 2 p.m. to Sunday 4 p.m.)
Price in force per post (four rods). Accompanying adults will have to pay the sum of €5.00 per night.
textes.peche.items.etang-fourchu.droits.items.0: Braided leader authorized at a maximum height of 30 cm.
textes.peche.items.etang-fourchu.droits.items.1: Return the fish flat to the water.
textes.peche.items.etang-fourchu.droits.items.2: Unhook the hook in the landing net.
Blocked lead assembly prohibited. (The fish must be able to free itself in the event of breakage.)
Prohibition on removing white cupids and sturgeons from the water.
textes.peche.items.etang-fourchu.meta.descripti: Fishing at the Fourchu pond in Florimont (90): 13 stations, no-kill fishing, open all year frost-free. Prices and online reservation.
textes.peche.items.etang-fourchu.reservation.pa: Reservations are required for any fishing session regardless of the duration. It is done from the site where you can proceed directly to the payment which will confirm your stay.

L’Étang Fourchu is limited to 13 stations for your comfort. Each station can accommodate one or two fishermen, it is imperative to specify the number of stations when booking. It is not possible to choose your position when booking. During busy periods (bridges, holidays, public holidays, etc.), remember to plan ahead. No refund can be made in the event of withdrawal.
textes.peche.items.etang-fourchu.resume: L'Étang Fourchu is limited to 13 stations for your comfort, each station being able to accommodate one or two fishermen, for a sport fishing experience in a preserved natural setting.
textes.peche.items.etang-fourchu.sous_titre: The site is open every day of the year, excluding frost periods.
textes.peche.items.etang-fourchu.tarification.a: Please note: a weekend session has a fixed price of €70 (from Friday 2 p.m. to Sunday 4 p.m.)
textes.peche.items.etang-fourchu.tarification.i: Price in force per post (four rods). Accompanying adults will have to pay the sum of €5.00 per night.
textes.peche.regles_communes.attention.texte: Concerning the ban on taking away or mutilating fish, any offender is liable to legal and criminal prosecution. The management of the Étang Fourchu estate disclaims all liability in the event of an accident, theft, damage to equipment or natural damage.
textes.peche.regles_communes.paragraphes.0: Please report to the guard post upon your arrival and before settling in. This step ensures the proper functioning of the site and the organization of fishing stations. To guarantee a pleasant session for everyone, it is strictly forbidden to change positions during the session.
textes.peche.regles_communes.paragraphes.1: A location is specifically dedicated to people with reduced mobility. If installed on another workstation, no privileges can be granted. Fishermen can unload their equipment as close as possible to the fishing station when possible. However, before any installation of the equipment, the vehicle must be returned to the parking lot.
textes.peche.regles_communes.paragraphes.2: Trash bins must be removed by the fisherman and must not remain on the site. Before departure, all equipment must be stored before returning the vehicle to the station for loading. After each session, the position is inspected by management. Failure to comply with the regulations may result in sanctions.
textes.peche.regles_communes.paragraphes.3: Starting from seed is prohibited during the winter period from November 1 to March 15.
textes.peche.regles_communes.paragraphes.4: It is nevertheless possible to bait with small seeds (hemps, barley, wheat) and to fish with sweet corn and seeds dried on hair. The guards will be uncompromising on this point and on the cooking of the seeds used.
textes.site.accroche: Enjoy an exceptional stay at the Domaine de l'Étang Fourchu in Florimont (90). Ideally located in the Territoire de Belfort, close to Alsace, our estate offers the rental of lodges with jacuzzi, a no-kill carp fishing pond and the direct sale of organic products on the farm.
textes.site.pied.proche_de: Close to: Delle, Belfort (90), Montbéliard, Héricourt, Altkirch, Mulhouse (Alsace), Porrentruy (Switzerland), as well as Ballon d'Alsace and the Franche-Comté / Haut-Rhin axis.
textes.site.pied.seo: Enjoy an exceptional stay at the Domaine de l'Étang Fourchu in Florimont (90). Ideally located in the Territoire de Belfort, close to Alsace, our estate offers the rental of lodges with jacuzzi, a no-kill carp fishing pond and the direct sale of organic products on the farm.
textes.site.titre_seo: Étang Fourchu | Lodges, Fishing & Organic Farm in Florimont (90)
